note: Spec pass 2026-10-15: groupings by an agent from the claims it read. No claim tests wise feedback itself (Cohen, Steele & Ross 1999 and Yeager et al. 2014 have no claim pages); the findings cover the page's premise (expectations patterned by group) and the wording of the positive comment. The brief identity-targeted interventions are separate neighbouring topics and are not grouped here. Halpern 2007 is a practice guide that reports the Mueller & Dweck finding.

findings.question: Do a feedback giver's expectations of a learner, or of the learner's group, show in the feedback given and in the learner's later performance?
Should the positive comment and the assurance speak to the learner's ability, or to their work and effort?
